# Samsung participant kit provenance

`samsung_theme05/` is an unmodified extraction of
`participant-kit/participant-kit/` from the user-supplied
`participant-kit-all-themes.zip` on 2026-09-23.

Archive SHA-256: `F3D359EACD2C455903482F17E2A73B7A5C635069FC9DF7B8913FFB0ABAD9B0ED`.

The Theme 02 nested archive was not imported because this project implements Theme 05.
Samsung's sample agent is retained only as a reference; Interra uses
`interra_submission:ParticipantAgent`. Runtime code does not import the scorer,
scenario generator, scenario files, ground truth, or organizer annotations.

This directory preserves the supplied materials and does not assert a new license for them.
